instruction:
Task: Perform a swipe gesture (e.g., Swipe Up) on the game grid.
Expected Result: Tiles slide/merge in the swipe direction as per 2048 rules. A new tile appears. Score updates. If the swipe is invalid (but game not over), grid is unchanged.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
